versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **http-status**: an instant, offline reference for all HTTP status codes.
- Provides lookup of meaning, common causes, and fix suggestions for any standard or unofficial code.
- Covers RFC, WebDAV, Nginx, Cloudflare, and other commonly used codes.
- Supports single-code explanations, code comparisons (e.g. 401 vs 403), and lists of retryable errors.
- No network, no dependencies — works fully offline.
